args.text: Fixing the 503 retry loop so transient errors are retried before surfacing.
Found the bug — the client aborts on the first failure instead of retrying. Now applying the fix.

Fixed retry loop in `vaultlite/client.py:18` to retry on `503` up to `retries` times, return immediately on `200`, and raise `VaultError` after exhaustion. Non-transient errors break immediately. Verified with `python -m unittest discover -s tests` (2/2 passed). Transport abstraction unchanged.
